Observed decision formulation: Rather than specifying latent constructs SCI, NA, and BSSI using single observed composite total indicators (SCI_T, PA_Negative, BSSI_T) with fixed error variance Var(y)*(1-alpha) per PRN-20260923-3A3A2B, statistics-agent implemented balanced factorial item parceling, creating 3 parcels each (sci_p1-3, na_p1-3, bssi_p1-3) from raw item sets.
statistics-agent executed Rscript 02_analysis_code/compute_stage45_macro_sem.R estimating latent SEM model using lavaan with MLR robust estimator.

observable_input.model_syntax: IUS =~ IUS_FA + IUS_RA; RRS =~ Ru_Ref + Ru_Bro + Ru_Dep; SCI =~ sci_p1 + sci_p2 + sci_p3; NA_lat =~ na_p1 + na_p2 + na_p3; BSSI =~ bssi_p1 + bssi_p2 + bssi_p3; RRS ~ a1*IUS + a2*SCI; NA_lat ~ b1*IUS + b2*SCI + d*RRS; BSSI ~ c1_prime*IUS + c2_prime*SCI + e1*RRS + e2*NA_lat
